months.note: 해마다 불규칙하게 찾아오며, 번식지에서는 4~6월에 알을 5~6개 낳는다.

summary: 초원과 관목 지대에 사는 드문 겨울새로, 해마다 찾아오는 정도가 불규칙하다. 이동할 때는 수십 마리씩 무리를 짓고, 그 뒤에는 작은 무리로 나뉘어 겨울을 난다. 자작나무류 씨앗과 석죽과 식물 열매를 즐겨 먹고 딱정벌레도 잡아먹는다. 전국에서 볼 수 있으며, 국외에서는 유라시아와 북아메리카, 아프리카 서북부에 분포한다.

points.en: black around the bill and on the throat

art.subject: Common Redpoll (Acanthis flammea), adult male in winter, as seen in Korea from November to March: small deep-red patch on the forehead and fore-crown; small black bib on the chin and black lores; rather pale buffish supercilium; upperparts greyish-buff to grey-brown, streaked dark brown; two pale wing-bars, the lower one broader; rump pale greyish-white with fine dark streaks; breast and cheeks with a variable pink wash, belly whitish, flanks streaked dark brown; small sharply pointed bill, yellowish with a dark culmen and tip; brown eye; dark brown legs.
art.pose: clinging to a birch twig, picking at seed catkins
art.scene: Korean winter scrubland and open grassland with leafless birches; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view perched on a birch twig: deep-red forecrown, black chin and lores, pale buffish supercilium, streaked greyish-buff back, two pale wing-bars, pale streaked rump, pink-washed breast in males, streaked flanks, dark brown legs
adult winter, head detail in profile: small red forecrown patch, black chin bib and lores, pale supercilium, tiny sharply pointed conical bill, yellowish with a dark culmen and tip
art.build: Small, slim finch about 13cm, a little smaller and slighter than a sparrow, with a small head and a fairly long, notched tail. Bill short, conical and needle-pointed, much shorter than the head, with straight edges. Legs short, dark brown. Long primary projection beyond the tertials. Feeds acrobatically, often hanging upside down on birch and alder catkins. Flight bouncy, showing the pale wing-bar and the pale streaked rump.
avoid: Do not colour the whole crown, head or throat red, and do not raise the red feathers into a crest; the red is a small, flat patch on the forehead and fore-crown.
Do not paint a large black face mask or a black throat; the black is only a small chin bib and the lores.
Do not paint a thick, long or all-dark bill; it is tiny, needle-pointed and yellowish with a dark culmen and tip.
Do not paint the frosty white, unstreaked rump and nearly plain flanks of Arctic Redpoll (Acanthis hornemanni).
Do not paint yellow wing-bars or yellow tail sides (Eurasian Siskin).
